Teams but (actually) good 0.6.3 -- BENIGN

Decisive diff evidence:
- popup.js and background.js are byte-identical between 0.6.2 and 0.6.3.
- manifest.json differs only in the version field.
- The dependency prefix of injection.js is unchanged. Comparing source modules
  independently of bundler order leaves changes in exactly five modules:
  gifs, popupChat, customName, settings, and plugin-registry. The first three
  update regex replacements for current Teams module shapes; settings updates
  its menu-label patch and adds console.log(value); plugin-registry reorders
  the same plugins. See earlier-release.diff for the complete module diff.
- 0.1.1 lacks the cache reset. This older baseline therefore distinguishes a
  subsequent feature addition from a malicious wipe. The reset is already
  present unchanged in 0.6.2: the alert is not new hostile code in 0.6.3.

Execution paths and effects:
- popup.html labels the control "Reset Teams Cache" and explicitly discloses
  clearing localStorage and IndexedDB before reloading.
- popup.js: clearCacheBtn click -> getActiveTab -> exact Teams hostname guard
  -> chrome.scripting.executeScript in MAIN -> remove non-extension-prefixed
  localStorage keys -> enumerate IndexedDB -> delete enumerated names -> reload
  the same tab with bypassCache. No load-time or timer invocation of this reset.
  A separate button clears only the extension's prefixed settings.
- background.js dynamically registers the bundled injection.js on Teams origins.
  Its GitHub requests read version/tag metadata for an update badge; downloaded
  text is not evaluated. On install it opens documentation and Teams.
- The WebSocket is loopback-only, defaults to disabled, is additionally gated
  off for Firefox, sends development status, and accepts only the literal reload
  command for chrome.runtime.reload. It is not an Internet tasking channel.
- Cookie authtoken_asm is copied to Teams tab sessionStorage for the custom-emoji
  UI. The image upload uses that token against Teams' asyncgw object API; no
  external token export appears. Emoji selection/upload is user initiated.
- injection.js patches Teams' webpack module factories, uses a replaced Trusted
  Types policy factory and the page's CSP nonce to run local UI patches, changes
  local display names via the conversations IndexedDB store, customizes channels,
  GIFs and input controls, and keeps status active. These match the advertised
  Teams customization purpose. Trusted Types factory replacement now has its
  own notable observation; it does not imply a malicious product verdict.
- GIF search sends only picker search text to Klipy. Settings synchronization
  requires a user click plus confirmation and serializes only the extension's
  prefixed main/plugin settings into a form POST to its published API.
- No concealed payload was found. Numeric strings in CodeMirror's bidi data
  are converted by dec() into 1 << digit lookup values used by charType().
  Lezer parser tables deserialize into parser state; percent-encoded SVGs are
  image assets. These are unchanged dependency/build data, not executable
  decoded commands. Reviewed raw facts and the code using these values.
- Cleave reports flow limitations for this bundle. Conclusions come from the
  actual callback registrations, guards, inputs and sinks, not absent alerts
  or unsupported assumptions about complete value-flow coverage.

Trait corrections:
- Relocate the generic injection + IndexedDB enumeration/deletion composite
  from hostile impact/destroy to notable data/db/web-storage. Keep its 4096-byte
  proximity gate and actual operations. Drop attack mappings and product-name
  exceptions: these mechanics cannot establish hostile intent on their own.
- Rename extension-own-indexeddb-reset to indexeddb-enumerate-delete: the API
  pair proves neither an extension nor ownership of the affected storage.
- Exclude query strings and fragments from the encoded-path fetch matcher.
  Existing query-parameter traits still describe the Klipy request.
- Bound TokenUser/UserSid as complete words. saveUsersIdAndName is not a
  Windows account SID reference.
- Consolidate the misplaced concat-loop marker with numeric loop bounds under
  control-flow/loop. Require the literal in the condition, not a findIndex()
  initializer argument. The ordinary 65..90 character-table loop remains notable.
  Integer bounds >=100 are intentionally included; no destructive intent follows.
- Relocate the unchanged generic fork-call matcher to control-flow/dispatch,
  and the unchanged WebSocket-named send matcher to websocket/send. Preserve
  the process-creation and server composites' exact references.
- The dispatch leaf was at its budget. Its generic message-event registration
  belongs under process/hook/event, independent of transport; move it unchanged
  and update all exact consumers. No arbitrary split or global budget increase.
- Ancestor-selector review found no consumers of the old concat/fork/send/event
  subtrees requiring a substitute. Existing loop-directory consumers now also
  see the correctly placed ordinary numeric-loop observation; the numeric
  source observation alone establishes no attack objective.

Verification:
- Ten focused positive/negative fixtures passed. They cover click reset,
  origin-local reset, enumeration without deletion, distant injection, query
  vs path, SID word boundaries, initializer vs loop bound, small/ordinary loops,
  generic fork vs process launch, client send vs server, function/arrow policy
  replacement vs normal policy creation and textual examples, and message events.
- Initial target scan: 1 hostile, 0 suspicious, 253 notable.
- Revised target scan: 0 hostile, 0 suspicious, 252 notable.
- Re-scanned both fetched earlier releases: 0 hostile and 0 suspicious.
- Ran atomscan again on the target after the trait edits; retained the real
  IndexedDB reset and Trusted Types factory observations at notable.

Reproduce focused controls from the repository root:
  cleave --traits-dir . --format json testdata/version-drift-teams-cache-reset/*.js -o /tmp/teams-controls.json
  python3 testdata/version-drift-teams-cache-reset/check.py /tmp/teams-controls.json

Final required gate: make validate.
